typography.font_strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' adapted for B2B. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for sharp, authoritative headings and 'Satoshi' for highly legible, geometric body text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look): Exposed skeleton for bento grids and tables. Use pure white cards against the off-white background with sharp 1px solid borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Avoid soft diffuse shadows for layout elements. Rely on 1px borders and occasional crisp drop-shadows only for popovers and dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px) for cards, buttons, and inputs. Never full rounded pills in the main dashboard.

layouts.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Strict hierarchy. Top KPI metrics in compact bento tiles without gaps (border-collapse look) or tight gap-4. Table-First structure below.
layouts.sidebar: Classic Sidebar. Fixed on left, distinct border-r separating from main content. Background #FFFFFF.
layouts.client_details: 3 Tabs (Visão geral, Módulos, Usuários). Grid of cards for Modules with toggle enable/disable.

components.name: Sidebar
components.instructions: Persistent left sidebar. Background #FFFFFF with dark text. Distinct border-r (#E5E5DF). Must have Dashboard, Clientes, Módulos links.

components.name: Data Tables
components.instructions: Dense tables for Clientes and Users. text-sm. Hover states on rows with slightly darker bg (#F9F9F6). Sticky header with border-b.

components.name: Tabs
components.instructions: Underline style, no pills. Active tab has #D95D39 text and underline.

components.name: Status Chips
components.instructions: Small inline pill (rounded-full or rounded-sm) with bold text. Use the status colors defined in the colors object.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially within status chips, meets APCA/WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all actionable items, e.g., data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='menu-dashboard'.

images.description: Minimalist geometric texture for the login split screen.

media.icons: lucide-react. Standardizing on Lucide since it's pre-installed. Use strokeWidth={1.5} for a crisper, more technical look.

motion.interactions: Crisp and minimal. Fast transform scale (0.98) on button clicks.
motion.page_transitions: None needed for dense dashboard. Use simple fade-in for tab contents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Shadcn UI for standard components but override borders to rounded-sm (2px) and use 1px solid borders for a 'Technical' grid look.
BANNED FONTS: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Space Grotesk.
Never use generic centered layouts. Dashboard metrics must be a rigid grid.
Do not use transparent dropdown backgrounds. Always give them solid background (#FFFFFF) with 1px border and a crisp shadow.
All text must be in Portuguese (BR). Example: Dashboard, Clientes, Módulos, Visão geral, Usuários.
Include data-testid on every button, link, and major interactive element.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but in this specific dashboard, rely on the GRID BORDERS structural approach.
Do not center align the app container.
Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
DO NOT use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided ones.
